opening.argument: The speaker actively presents a cloud Bitcoin-mining service and solicits participation by directing viewers toward registration through a referral link. The service is identified as cloud mining, while the presentation gives specific weekly, monthly, and annual earnings figures and describes purchasing mining power. It also promotes refunds and fast withdrawals, and asks viewers to create an account, provide personal details, and fund the service with Bitcoin or card payments. Although the speaker mentions prior mining and betting experiences, those qualifications do not change the direct endorsement and request for participation in the promoted mining page.
